programme.desc: Divertente commedia con Claudio Bisio, Claudia Pandolfi, Giuseppe Battiston e Angela Finocchiaro. Sette inseparabili amici si trovano a cambiare ruolo sia in campo che nella vita.

programme.title: Intervista a Matilda De Angelis
programme.desc: Matilda De Angelis, protagonista del film "La lezione" con Stefano Accorsi, ci racconta aneddoti e curiosità sul set del thriller diretto da Stefano Mordini.

programme.title: Io rimango qui
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Frank Pope, un drammatico e coraggioso inno alla vita. La sedicenne Steffi scopre di essere gravemente malata, ma rifiuta le cure per partire a bordo del suo pick up in un viaggio avventuroso verso Parigi insieme a Steve, un ragazzo alla ricerca di se stesso.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Road movie con Finn Cole e Margot Robbie, amanti in fuga nell’America degli anni 30. La temuta fuorilegge Allison Wells entra nella vita del giovane orfano texano Eugene Evans.

programme.title: Nove lune e mezza
programme.desc: Michela Andreozzi dirige e interpreta una commedia con Claudia Gerini e Giorgio Pasotti. Livia accetta di fungere da madre surrogata per co della sorella, all'insaputa dei rispettivi fidanzati.

programme.title: Tutti in piedi
programme.desc: Franck Dubosc e Alexandra Lamy in una commedia romantica. Jocelyn, dongiovanni impenitente, non si ferma davanti a niente quando vuole sedurre una donna. Egoista e bugiardo, finge di essere disabile per conquistare la bella Marie. La messa in scena del playboy si complica pero' quando la donna gli presenta sua sorella Florence, la quale e' costretta veramente a vivere su una sedia a rotelle. Jocelyn dovra' fare i conti con un aspetto da lui sempre trascurato, il sentimento, quello che inizia a provare per Florence. Diretto dallo stesso Franck Dubosc, al suo esordio dietro la macchina da presa.

programme.title: Mia moglie è un fantasma
programme.desc: Brillante commedia con Dan Stevens, Leslie Mann, Isla Fisher e Judi Dench basata sull’omonimo racconto. Per uscire dal blocco creativo, uno scrittore si rivolge a un’eccentrica medium, che rievoca lo spirito dell’ex moglie. Questa presenza susciterà le gelosie dell’attuale consorte.

programme.title: La rivolta delle ex
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey e Jennifer Garner in una commedia romantica dal tocco soprannaturale. Connor Mead è un celebre fotografo che ha un enorme fascino sulle donne: nessuna riesce a resistergli, e lui da cinico playboy passa da un'avventura all'altra. Per lui non esistono relazioni stabili, tanto meno il matrimonio. E di questo cerca di convincere anche il fratello minore, che invece sta per sposarsi, ma i fantasmi delle sue numerose ex cominciano a perseguitarlo, mostrandogli quello che sarà il suo futuro. Nel cast, anche Michael Douglas.

programme.title: 7 ore per farti innamorare
programme.desc: Giampaolo Morelli dirige e interpreta una commedia romantica con Serena Rossi e Diana Del Bufalo. Un giornalista segue un corso di 'arte del rimorchio' per riconquistare la sua ex.

programme.title: Giovani, carini e disoccupati
programme.desc: Ben Stiller dirige Winona Ryder e Ethan Hawke in una commedia generazionale. Una giovane laureata filma i suoi amici per raccontarne dubbi, frustrazioni e aspirazioni artistiche.

programme.title: Beata te
programme.desc: Serena Rossi e Fabio Balsamo nella commedia Sky Original di Paola Randi. Marta riceve la visita dell'Arcangelo che le annuncia l'arrivo di un figlio. Basteranno 14 giorni per decidere?

programme.title: Un ragazzo d'oro
programme.desc: Sharon Stone in una pellicola di Pupi Avati con Riccardo Scamarcio. Dopo il suicidio del padre scrittore, il figlio tenta di pubblicarne il libro incompiuto scoprendo scottanti verita'.

programme.title: It Ends with Us - Siamo noi a dire basta
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Colleen Hoover, un dramma sentimentale con Blake Lively. Dopo il funerale del padre, Lily torna a Boston per aprire un negozio di fiori e si innamora di Ryle, un affascinante neurochirurgo, ma l'uomo possiede un lato oscuro e violento che sta per riaffiorare.

programme.desc: Franck Dubosc e Alexandra Lamy in una commedia romantica. Jocelyn, dongiovanni impenitente, non si ferma davanti a niente quando vuole sedurre una donna. Egoista e bugiardo, finge di essere disabile per conquistare la bella Marie. Diretto dallo stesso Franck Dubosc, al suo esordio dietro la macchina da presa.

programme.title: Babygirl
programme.desc: Coppa Volpi a Venezia a Nicole Kidman in un dramma erotico con Harris Dickinson e Antonio Banderas. Una donna sposata, amministratice delegata di un'azienda importante, inizia una relazione clandestina con un giovane stagista che la trascina in una spirale di perversione.

programme.title: Il grande Gatsby
programme.desc: Baz Luhrmann (il regista di "Mouline Rouge!") dirige Leonardo DiCaprio, Carey Mulligan e Tobey Maguire nello sfarzoso adattamento, vincitore di due Oscar, del celebre romanzo di Francis S. Fitzgerald, pilastro della letteratura statunitense. America, anni '20: un aspirante scrittore, Nick Carraway, entra nel mondo di Jay Gatsby, un misterioso milionario ossessionato dall'amore impossibile per Daisy: la donna da lui amata e che vorrebbe riconquistare. Nick verra' a contatto con l'atmosfera festosa dell'eta' del jazz che si consuma in illusioni, malinconie e sogni effimeri.

programme.title: L'amore, in teoria
programme.desc: Una commedia sentimentale di Luca Lucini con Nicolas Maupas. Un brillante studente di filosofia viene ingiustamente accusato di un reato che non ha commesso e condannato ai servizi sociali, dove incontra Flor, un'attivista che gli cambiera' la vita.

programme.title: Giovani, carini e disoccupati
programme.desc: Ben Stiller dirige Winona Ryder e Ethan Hawke in una commedia generazionale. Una giovane laureata filma i suoi amici per raccontarne dubbi, frustrazioni e aspirazioni artistiche.

programme.title: Lei mi parla ancora
programme.desc: Pupi Avati dirige Renato Pozzetto e un grande cast nel film Sky Original ispirato al romanzo di Giuseppe Sgarbi. Dopo la morte della moglie, un uomo ripercorre la storia d'amore di una vita.

programme.title: Pane e burlesque
programme.desc: Laura Chiatti e Sabrina Impacciatore in una piccante commedia a tinte rosa. Un paesino del Sud, in crisi e affollato di cassaintegrati dopo la chiusura della fabbrica di ceramiche, viene scosso dall'arrivo di Mimi' la Petite e della sua compagnia di burlesque. Il loro destino si intreccia con quello di Matilde e Teresa, in cerca di un'occasione perche' anche la merceria dove lavorano accusa le difficolta' economiche. Mimi', pero', e' arrivata in citta' anche per un altro motivo: e' infatti la figlia del proprietario della fabbrica e deve vendere le proprieta' di famiglia.

programme.title: Miller's Girl
programme.desc: Miller's Girl.

programme.title: It Ends with Us - Siamo noi a dire basta

programme.title: Amore a seconda vista
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Famiglia all'improvviso", un'incantevole commedia romantica con Francois Civil e Joséphine Japy. Un famoso romanziere si risveglia in un mondo parallelo e capisce di dover riconquistare Olivia, la donna che ama e che ha già sposato nella sua vita originale.

Adam scopre che suo padre (Kevin Kline) ha sedotto la sua fidanzata. Davanti a un simile trauma, il ragazzo si ubriaca e finisce a casa di Emma. I due, amici di lunga data, finiscono a letto insieme e decidono di instaurare una relazione puramente fisica, senza alcun coinvolgimento: ci si diverte ma i sentimenti devono esser tenuti ben lontani. Un reciproco accordo che sembra anche funzionare, ma sara' sempre piu' difficile tenere a bada il cuore...

programme.desc: Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves in una love story che trascende lo spazio e il tempo. Arrivato nella sua nuova casa sul lago, Alex trova una lettera della precedente inquilina, Kate, con cui inizia un rapporto epistolare. I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. Ispirato a "Il mare", film coreano inedito in Italia diretto da Hyun-Seung Lee, con Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves che tornano a lavorare insieme 12 anni dopo "Speed".

programme.desc: Oliver Stone dirige Al Pacino e un cast di divi per descrivere il mondo del football americano attraverso la storia di un allenatore in crisi, alla guida di una squadra che non sa piu' vincere. Tony D'Amato e i suoi Miami Sharks perdono una partita dietro l'altra, il quarterback titolare e' fuori per infortunio e la giovane e affascinante proprietaria della squadra e' decisa a far fuori il coach. Ma mandarlo via non e' per nulla facile, la squadra e' con Tony e tra un problema e l'altro riesce a qualificarsi per i playoff. Dentro o fuori, non ci sono alternative.

Segnato dalla morte della figlia, Howard, un pubblicitario di New York, si chiude in se stesso perdendo ogni interesse per cio' che lo circonda. L'unica sua reazione concreta consiste nella scrittura di lettere indirizzate alla Morte, al Tempo e all'Amore. Ai suoi amici non resta che assecondarlo mentre escogitano un piano per aiutarlo a riprendere in mano la propria vita. Dal regista de "Il diavolo veste Prada". Cast da tappeto rosso: Edward Norton, Keira Knightley, Naomie Harris e i premi Oscar Helen Mirren e Kate Winslet.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: When Marcus leaves for sleep-away camp, Phoebe discovers that being a “family fairy” means helping everyone in your assigned family, not just the children. / When Tracy hires Cassie to babysit Nicholas, and Eden asks Athena and Phoebe to lend a helping hand, Cassie and the Dews must find a way to get Nicholas to bed without his missing and beloved penguin stuffy.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: When Eden finds an \"injured\" Hammy out of his cage and helps him recuperate in her own home, she finds it harder and harder to get her \"new guest\" to return to his own home. / When Marcus forgets his lunch at home, Phoebe and the Dews must find a way to deliver him his lunch during his class's field trip to the park, but when they lose his lunch they must work to create a new and nutritious alternative.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go
programme.desc: When Rodney accidentally catches Sam when she falls from a tree and starts to believe he’s a hero TZG secretly follow him around town to make sure his clumsy hero-ing doesn’t go wrong. / When Lula and Luis want a clubhouse for the Squasher Fan Club, TZG secretly help fix up the shed in Luis’ backyard.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go
programme.desc: When various townsfolk report having lost soft belongings, TZG secretly investigates to discover thieving pigeon Yolanda had been building a nest for baby gophers. / When Ian’s lucky badminton racket goes missing, TZG secretly finds and returns it in time for a rematch against his toughest opponent.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a suitcase and a hotel brochure, it’s time to take a trip to The Dollhouse Hotel! Hotel guests Gabby and Pandy check in with the Hotel Manager DJ Catnip then go to Mercat’s Spa and even order room service from Pillow Cat! For our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, Pillow Cat sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
programme.desc: Huzzah! Gabby the Bold and Pandy the Purr-owd are Knights in Training, and they head into the dollhouse for the Royal Knighting Ceremony. But it turns out that someone's locked King Catnip in the tower and without him they'll have to cancel the Royal Knighting Ceremony! It's up to the Knights in Training to solve the mystery and save King Catnip by performing acts of knighthood. For our Cat of the Day, Pandy makes a shield craft!

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods
programme.desc: Eep, Thunk, Lerk, and Womp set out to make it to the end of “The Tunnel of Terror” within the Cave of Secrets; After being rescued by a mysterious creature at the watering hole, Thunk tries to convince the Valley that a “sea thing” exists and it's not just his imagination.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods
programme.desc: When Grug wakes up without a voice, he and Ugga go on the hunt to find his voice, while Eep, Thunk, and Gran stay behind. But when the Valleyites come to Eep with questions for Grug, she takes this opportunity to be a leader by pretending to have a conversation with Grug in their cave.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: After a baby says a swear word on live television (censored by child-friendly online filter Sheriff Potty Pardner), Boss becomes obsessed with proving that the baby was taught this filth by their new arch-nemesis, Lumpy the Park Duck. Meanwhile, Tina's search to find what that swear word means creates unintentional havoc for both Tabitha's research paper and for Baby Corp's online systems when Sheriff Potty Pardner gives them an \"internet time out\".

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: After Boss insults Tina's imaginary friend, he's forced into \"Imaginary Friend Sensitivity Training\" at Baby Corp. Boss makes up his own imaginary friend to get out of these meetings, but after Tina gets a whiff that he may be lying, he's forced to keep up the charade at work and at home.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge
programme.desc: After heroes Hiccup and Toothless save Barf and Belch's life, the grateful Zippleback tries to repay its life debt and abandons riders Ruff and Tuff.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge
programme.desc: Determined to create a key to the Dragon Eye, Ryker heads to Glacier Island to find the dangerous Snow Wraith being protected by the Dragon Riders.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants
programme.desc: Captain Underpants becomes a wanted man in underwear when footage surfaces of a robber who looks exactly like him. George and Harold, positive it's an impostor, try to track down the perp and bring him to justice. But can the boys do this before Captain Underpants is found guilty?

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants
programme.desc: As a prank, George and Harold use Melvin's new animal hybrid invention to create a creature that's a cross between a butt and a fly. But some of the monster butt-erflies want to eat everything in sight- including the students hiding out in the school gym!

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia
programme.desc: Aja, Krel, and Vex explore Earth looking for technology to repair their ship. When the high school Principal demands to meet Aja and Krel's guardians, the Royal teens transform two maintenance robots (Blanks) to pose as their \"human\" parents.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia
programme.desc: In an effort to blend in with their surroundings, Krel engineers a device to get into the \"mind-set\" of humans and ends up discovering far more than he expected. Meanwhile, General Morando's bounty hunters close in on the Royals.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia
programme.desc: When an alien beetle infestation threatens to expose their true identities, the Royals must depend on a new ally for help. Meanwhile, Zadra joins Morando’s army as a double agent who secretly spies on him for the growing Resistance.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: The Templeton’s hometown is overtaken by baby criminals, with Temp Baby Aubrey in charge. Boss has 48 hours to somehow restore them all to adulthood and turn them in, or face jail time himself. With Tina now acting like a dark angel of vengeance after feeling betrayed by Aubrey, Boss is forced to assemble a team from unlikely odd friends. Together, they launch a final mission to settle old scores and clear Boss Baby’s name.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: After the events of the Boss Baby 2 film, adult businessman Theodore Templeton is framed for embezzling from his company and forced to revert back to his old Boss Baby self and crash with his brother Tim. But to pull this off, he'll need to win over Tim's family into letting him stay, and convince Baby Corp to give him back his old job... which is currently held by his baby niece Tina.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: Tina and Boss adjust to co-boss responsibilities while on a mission to rescue the baby with the best hair in the world from a lice outbreak. With opposing leadership views, the two split the existing field team's focus and discover a new archenemy in Lumpy the Park Duck.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight
programme.desc: The team arrives in India where an old friend of Rukhmini can supposedly give them a pendant that will lead to the next Tianshang weapon. But when they arrive, they find that Rukhmini’s hometown has changed a lot in the thirty years she’s been gone, and her old friend Diya might not be willing to help them.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight
programme.desc: The team plans a heist in order to obtain the enchanted pendant that can lead them to the storm wheels. Elsewhere, Klaus and Veruca shipwreck on a mysterious island that is actually home to the mages, and also the Tianshang weapon helmet.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight
programme.desc: Po and the team have one last attempt to get the pendant, but they will have to disrupt Jayesh's wedding, and contend with his guards, to do so. At the mage island, Klaus and Veruca get hold of the Tianshang helmet.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy
programme.desc: The PALs run into their old rivals the BUDs on the first day of classes, prompting Lucky to run for class rep. Elsewhere, Abigail helps solve a mystery.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy
programme.desc: After meeting her riding idols, Pru vows to practice until she's perfect — even if it means missing out on a bonfire her best friends are planning.

Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. programme.title: Iron Ball
programme.desc: This sports entertainment show brings the best special forces from Iron Squad to take on a new challenge – dodgeball. Witness how they compete in front of the star athletes and legendary dodgeball coaches!

programme.desc: A family of aswang attempt to transition into a living a more normal, less monstrous life.

programme.title: Para Sa Hopeless Romantic
programme.desc: A student writer struggles to find a happy ending for her romantic story when her own real life romance falls apart.

programme.title: May-December-January
programme.desc: A story about Claire a single mom and a career woman. She is aware that her son is gay and accepts this wholeheartedly. What breaks her heart, though, is finding out that they are both in love with the same man.

programme.title: Itutumba Ka ng Tatay Ko
programme.desc: Teteng, a single father and assistant to a film director, faces his last days due to a brain tumor. Despite his fear of confrontation, he becomes determined to protect his tomboyish daughter Tintin from bullies. Teteng, romantically interested in Tintin's teacher, discovers his illness and gets involved in a bar fight, leading to Tintin's kidnapping by a crime boss. With nothing to lose, Teteng fights relentlessly, showcasing his strength and love for his daughter until his final moments.

programme.desc: Janet and Ian started a simple life together, but will their maried life be as happy as they dreamed to be when both their parents treat each other as enemy?

programme.title: Gen Z ep 2
programme.desc: Gen Z is a series which portrays how the younger generation deals with life's struggles while striving to achieve their ambitions and its impact on their relationships with family and friends.

programme.title: Kurdapya ep 12
programme.desc: Kurdapya tells the story of long-lost twins, KURING \u0026 DAPHNE. They meet after a strange accident and discover that they lead extremely different lives. Kuring grew up with the cruel extended family in the province while Daphne is an undervalued publishing executive in the city. Both women want to get out of their current realities, so they decide to switch lives by pretending to be each other.

programme.title: Lumuhod ka sa Lupa Bagong Yugto ep 15
programme.desc: The saga continues in the second season/installment of the classic Carlo J. Caparas' adaptation. Stars Kiko Estrada, Sarah Labahti, and Gardo Versoza.

programme.title: Lumuhod ka sa Lupa Bagong Yugto ep 16
programme.desc: The saga continues in the second season/installment of the classic Carlo J. Caparas' adaptation. Stars Kiko Estrada, Sarah Labahti, and Gardo Versoza.

programme.title: Operation Break the Casanova's Heart ep 3
programme.desc: After Stephen, the school's casanova, breaks the heart of Naomi's bestfriend, Kryzel, Naomi becomes determined to seek revenge. In her effort to do so, she is discovered by the HSCC (Haters of Stephen Cruz Coalition), a secret group composed of Stephen's ex-girlfriends who seek revenge on Stephen and recruits her on their mission guided by 10 steps to break the casanova's heart.

programme.title: Totoy Bato ep 223
programme.desc: The series is based on the graphic novel created by Carlo J. Caparas. Totoy Bato, a young man, fighting for justice for his lost loved ones; also fighting for equality and fairness against his old friend turned nemesis Dwayne.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures S1 ep 9
programme.desc: A clairvoyant repairman fearful of ghosts is forced to help them cross over so they can leave him in peace. On his journey of helping these ghosts with their unfinished businesses, he ends up getting into trouble with their families, friends and the community they are all living in. Will he be able to get these ghosts and their love ones, at the same time face his fear of them?

programme.title: Sari Saring Sine: Campus Girls
programme.desc: Vangie, Georgie, Samantha and Diane are best of friends who encounter different journeys in life as they go through college. Their friendship gets tested when Diane and Georgie fight over the affections of college heartthrob Louie, while Samantha discovers that Vangie is her dad's young mistress.

programme.title: Gen Z ep 3
